posts.content_md:
In the stores now! The Holiday Kleenex box!

Usually they have a box with Fresnel lenses embossed on the sides, which look like Xmas Tree Ornaments. This year there's an overall grating pattern background with Fresnel Zone Plates to give the ornament look. Another addition to your holography packaging collection!

posts.author: jeff-blyth
posts.content_md:
> **Ed Wesly:** In the stores now! The Holiday Kleenex box!Usually they have a box with Fresnel lenses embossed on the sides, which look like Xmas Tree Ornaments. This year there's an overall grating pattern background with Fresnel Zone Plates to give the ornament look. Another addition to your holography packaging collection!

Yes, last year I cut one of those Fresnel lens Kleenex boxes up (the silver ones were best) and left it soaking in an acetone/strong hydrochloric acid

solution. The plastic was removed off the cardboard and the aluminized backing dissolved into the HCl. The little Fresnel lenses were amazingly good. What a waste to put them on disposable boxes! However they were

reducing lenses. Then my colleague Colin Davidson poured PDMS monomer solution over them , (gelatin would have worked too) and pealed it off once it had set . They made perfect imprints but can you guess the major change that had occurred? ........................

They became magnifiers!

Jeff
